cuts.label: Take 1
cuts.notes: Transcript: WALT! (9.4 s) / What is the story, Walt? (10.9) / Same as yesterday, Eddie. (13.1) / Different stool. (14.8), all correct. Calm sepia cross-fades of the bar and its regulars, then our own gold-script Regulars title fading in over a sign-free shopfront, then a cut to the colour bar scene; the scene was generated on its own and joined, because extending from the sepia intro was blocked twice.

cuts.label: Take 2
cuts.notes: Transcript: WALT! (9.6 s) / What is the story, Walt? (10.7) / Same as yesterday, Eddie. (13.2) / Different stool. (15.0). Same sepia intro and Regulars title; in the new scene Walt walks in silent and tips his cap, the regulars and Eddie turn and shout WALT! while his mouth stays closed, then the lines and the laugh.

cuts.label: Take 3 (ending fixed)
cuts.notes: Transcript: WALT! (9.6 s) / What is the story, Walt? (10.7) / Same as yesterday, Eddie. (13.6) / Different stool. (15.4), all correct, then a studio laugh. Take 2 is untouched up to 13.04 s, the end of Walt walking up to the bar. After that, Take 2 drifted: the camera slid left while signs with lettering and a new man appeared, then cut at 14.85 s to a crisp, modern-looking two-shot with a recast Walt and a rebuilt back bar (regulars3/NOTES.md). The new ending is three single shots started from stills of the approved footage. First, Walt at the end of the bar delivers both lines with a beat between them, in one locked-off take that continues seamlessly from Take 2 frame 312 (reg3-walt-lines-t2). Then a cutaway to the approved close shot of Eddie cracking up (reg3-eddie-laugh-t1). Then back on the wide as Walt settles onto his different stool and the picture fades (reg3-walt-sit-t3). The shots keep their own laughter, with an ElevenLabs studio-audience laugh (audio/reg3-laugh.mp3) underneath from the cut to Eddie. Edit: regulars3/edit.mjs.

cuts.label: Take 4 (too much else)
cuts.notes: Transcript: There's a place where they remember you, where the light is always on (sung, 2.1 s) / WALT! (10.8) / How do you know my name? I've literally never been here before. (12.4) / Get the car back from the shop okay, Walt? (16.7) / Yeah, it was just the... wait. (19.0) / How'd the colonoscopy go, Walt? (22.7) / Saw you eat frosting straight out of the can last night, Walt. (27.0) / Standing in the dark kitchen. (30.9) / Your usual, Walt. (34.1) / Yeah... I'm out of here. (35.6) / Bye, Walt! (41.7), all correct. New sepia intro of the same four regulars in five eras, never ageing, under a new original theme; then five joke levels, one shot per line or reaction, with Walt's reactions climbing and the laugh growing, then dropping away for his freeze and exit. 45.2 s. Compare Take 4 without the dark kitchen. Edit: reg4/edit.mjs.

cuts.label: Take 4 (too much else, no dark kitchen)
cuts.notes: Transcript: as Take 4 (too much else) without "Standing in the dark kitchen.": the frosting line ends on "...last night, Walt." (27.0 s) and Eddie's "Your usual, Walt." follows at 31.8. Same takes and timing otherwise; everything after the frosting comes 2.375 s earlier. 42.8 s. Edit: reg4/edit.mjs --short.
